prompt: The heap has two free holes, one of 512 bytes and then one of 256 bytes, separated by used blocks (no other free space). Two requests arrive in order: 200 bytes, then 300 bytes.

trace.label: First fit places the 200-byte request in the hole of
Best fit places the 200-byte request in the hole of

explain: First fit takes the first hole that is big enough, so 200 bytes go into the 512 hole, leaving about 288 bytes. The 300-byte request then fits nowhere. Best fit puts the 200-byte request in the *tightest* hole that fits, the 256 one, which leaves the 512 hole whole for the 300-byte request.
